sentences.text:
Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6880 of 2023
Applicant :- Dr. Abhishek Yadav

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Arun K. Singh Deshwal,Anil Kumar Dubey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant Dr.Abhishek Yadav with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.27-F of 2015, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471,
406, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali, District Gorakhpur during pendency of the trial.
It is alleged in the F.I.R. that the informant had taken admission in Raj Nursing and Paramedical College, Gorakhpur for academic session 2012-13.

entities.text: Raj Nursing and Paramedical College, Gorakhpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: After completion of one year course due to some legal problem only forty students were allowed for examination and 20 students including first informant could not appear in the exam.
First informant has deposited Rs. 3,00,000/- in the said institution as fees.

Thereafter, the first informant approached to District Magistrate, Gorakhpur and their exams were conducted but till date result of the first informant had not been declared and due to that reason, the first informant could not appear in other exams.

Dr. Abhishek Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192297530/
1

entities.text: Abhishek Yadav vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Applicant permitted first informant for appearing in examination but due to some legal problem, his result has not been declared.
Then he lodged the present F.I.R. against the applicant.
There is delay in lodging the F.I.R. and there is no explanation regarding delay.
Learned counsel for the applicant next submitted that there is no evidence against the applicant regarding committing of any forgery or criminal breach of trust.

Criminal history of the applicant has clearly been explained in para no. 25 of the bail application,
wherein he has already been granted bail.
There is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future due to heavy dockets.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 13.04.2022 and in case he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Dr. Abhishek Yadav, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 SKD  Dr. Abhishek Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192297530/
